$comment: Inner Depth model registry. Only entries with status 'approved' may receive participant notes. Capabilities and privacy eligibility are re-verified at runtime against the OpenRouter catalog (see catalog.js); this file records what was verified when the entry was added and the evaluation state. Add a model here as 'candidate', run tools/inner-depth-eval.mjs, review the results, then set status to 'approved'.

privacy_policy.note: ZDR endpoints only. Gemini models are served by Google as Safety Retention, not ZDR, and are excluded unless INNER_DEPTH_ALLOW_SAFETY_RETENTION=true. Anthropic first-party and OpenAI first-party endpoints are not ZDR on OpenRouter; Claude is served ZDR via Amazon Bedrock and Google Vertex, GPT via Azure.

models.approval_basis: Provisional pilot approval: structured outputs, reasoning and ZDR endpoints verified in the catalog on 2026-11-27 (Fireworks, Together, DeepInfra, Nebius and others). Full evaluation pending.
models.notes: Economical for rewording, clarifying questions and simple sessions. Many providers; routing may land on any ZDR endpoint.
